nom: Philosophy Hope In A Jar Instant Glow Peeling Mousse

avis.texte: I have only used it 3 times but noticed a difference in my skin after one use. Its smoother looks bouncy and glowing. Very gentle way to exfoliate.
I've been using this product for at least a decade. It removes dry flaky skin that won't come off without this product.
I used this product for the first time tonight and it was excellent.
This is the best for exfoliation. I have sensitive skin and haven't had any issues. Makes my skin look and feel great!

avis.titre: Favorite skincare product, but not for all skin types
avis.texte: I have used this for years, LOVE IT. I use it 2-3 times a week, and I only use it a 3rd time if my skin is going through it due to excess oily skin from hormones. My skin is somewhat mixed, ususlly extremely dry and flakey, with lots of oil build up around my nose/sinus area and chin. This product is perfect for people with my skin, and I've NEVER found or used another quite like it. I live in Florida humidity, so my skin really takes a hit all the time. I've used this product on my ex before, and his skin was more oily/rubbery with lots of clogged pores. For him, it never worked. I mean, when I use it, I get a BUNCH of rolled up dead skin. For him, NOTHING came off. It really is meant for people with dryer skin types, but I PROMISE this is so worth it and I am only writing this bc I pray they will never remove it. Philosophy, if you ever take this off the shelf, please send me a lifetime supply first!!!!

I absolutely have no idea what this product does? It did nothing for me! I LOVE Philosophy products but this peeling mousse product is a mystery to me. It doesn't do anything. I don't recommend this product at all.
I love this product. you will be amazes how much dead skin that will roll up to a ball
I really like this product. Makes your skin smooth and fresh! I wish you would carry this in a the larger size. I have purchased it from this site and QVC.

avis.titre: present a new face every morning
avis.texte: I like the way my skin feels after I use this in the evening. Seems as though it's a good prep for products I use before going to bed. Leaves a fresh new layer of skin for the next day, similar to a glycolic peel only not as pricey.

I desperately needed some sort of face exfoliating product and asked an associate for assistance. She recommended this. After just one use my skin looked soooo much better and it took about 2 minutes to use. I didnt realize how gross my face was. Huge improvement! I've used it a couple of times now and can't wait to use it again. Thanks Ulta Associate, whoever you are! And thank you, Philosophy! This stuff is the best.

ok so you rub it around your face and it looks like it's working and sheeding your dull dead skin, but it's actually just the product drying and balling up. I have visibly dry shedding skin and decided to test this theory, and sure enough, after I used this the dead patchy skin was still there on my face and all that was in my hands was this product. Waste of money, disappointed to say the least.

The first time I used this it left my face feeling very soft. I've used it 2x now and still waiting for the "glow". It's easy to use, so I'm giving it some time and will step up to 2-3x weekly, in addition to weekly microdelivery vit C peels.

This product is AMAZING!!! My skin is loving this peeling mousse. This product is a pretty baby blue, thick, creamy, and soft to the touch. It LITERALLY rolls away impurities and it smells soooo good!! My skin was left glowing and baby soft. I DEF will be restocking this product.
It smells great. It didn't seem like a peel to me however. I expected it to give me a smoother finish but it honestly just seemed like a regular old face wash. Nothing too special.

Having tried several other physical exfoliants I wasn't sure what to expect with Hope in a Jar Peeling Mousse, but I have been blown away by the results! It never irritates, burns, or stings my skin, but it's truly exfoliates away any dead skin or flakes I have been following the instructions exactly as they are and by the end of the one minute if massaging it into my face and rinsing I can feel the results immediately This is one of the best physical exfoliants that I have used and I really like the texture of the gel as well as the scent. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone that is looking for a gentle physical exfoliant

Upping my skincare and recently found philosophy. Bought their skin care line and used this tonight and man… This is the holy grail. I suffer from light rosacea and my skin is usually pretty sensitive. I used this and omg, so much dead skin came off it was disgusting! This was after cleansing too. Definitely will be a weekly use for me. The bottle is tall, but there's not much in it, but it's worth every penny. Made my skin feel buttery smooth. Absolutely will be recommending it to everyone!
This was a new product for me... I loved it! It works so well! It comes out of the tube nicely, rubs into the skin well, and creates an extremely smooth skin!

I have sensitive skin and this works amazingly well for me. My skin is soft and smooth when using this product. I ran out and used a different product for awhile. Nothing else even comes close to it for me. Going forward, I will keep a spare bottle on hand!
Love this product. It make a big difference in my skin feeling soft and glowing! Gently run it in and leave. it on for about 2 minutes before washing off.
I am so happy that I found this product. It gets rid of dry skin in 1 minute. Wish the packaging was bigger
My skin has never felt so smooth or glowed so well as it has after using this! A new must!
I have the best glow after using this - and my skin feels so fresh and new!!
I have used this product twice. I love the dead skin it takes off & leaves my face super smooth.
Magic….pure magic! Make my face and neck so smooth! Love it!

avis.titre: Excellent love the texture & the results!
avis.texte: This is my third purchase of this item have been using it with great results. Easy to use smells great very subtle and not gritty at all. Really love this product & would highly recommend plus it lasts quite awhile hard to find in the stores and cannot beat the deals offered on this website! Thank You!!
Its a nice product Its a nice product Its a nice product Its a nice product
This product is one of my go tos! I use it at least two times a week. It is amazing at sloughing off old dead skin. After just one use, you can see a difference in your skin! Highly recommend!

I have tried the Peter Thomas Roth one and it didn't do anything for me. So, I saw this because my face has been DRY. So fry it flakes and incredibly hard and painful to get rid of the dryness with a beauty razor thing, whatever it is called. I don't exfoliate and that is one of my issues. I also don't drink water like I should: it tastes weird to me. I have obviously issues with my 32 year old self. Anyhow, came across this line at Ulta. I have tried this brand in moisturizer before and it BROKE me out. So, I was hesitant, but the product description had me hooked. This stuff does semi work, but it wouldn't be as powerful without the acid treatment I use too: from this brand. The first time I use it: my face felt clamy/Chalky. Hard to explain. Not soft, smooth, nor matte. Odd. I thought it had worked. It felt not dry at least. I didn't use this alone to give you that experience. I then used the exfoliating weird pump product from this brand: forgot the name of it. Overall, stand-alone just this product would not work for me. It works okay with the product above, but my skin is too dry for this alone. If you decide to get this don't have severe dry skin like mine. It didn't break me out.
My skin feels amazing. Non drying, non irritating. My products work better and my make goes on more smoothly. This is a win.

avis.titre: Must have for weekly in home facial!!
avis.texte: My skin looked amazing. I love instant glow peeling mousse. My son is addicted to the glow peeling mousse. I will be purchasing one for him so I can keep mine.

I got this as a sample in a previous purchase. Most of the time I give away the peels because I have very sensitive skin. Since this one only takes 1 minute, I thought I would try. IT WAS AWESOME! So much dry skin came off that hadn't come off with other products. My face was so soft I made my husband feel it. Now I'm ordering a full size. Thanks for the sample!
I have used the hope in a jar instant glow peeling mousse for a few weeks. I truly see results for ageing. I will continue to use this product.

Smells amazing! Its a thick blue consistency, you out on clean dry skin and massage for one minute. I then take it off with a damo warm towel. It leaves my face feeling baby soft and not tight and stripped.

I first got this a few years ago as a sample and have been buying it ever since. A holy grail item for me. I'm post menopausal and my skin is dry and flaky and normal exfoliators don't really work well. I use this daily in the evenings and it helps my moisturizer go on smoothly and keeps me looking fresher.
I really liked adding this before my face wash I seemed to remove a good bit of oil and dirt. I liked how clean my skin felt before the rest of my routine.
It's been a while since I have used a peel so I was scared to say the least. It was easy and smelled nice and didn't irritate my skin. My skin felt soft afterward. I would use it again.

I am totally in love with this product. I like the texture, how you can easily control the amount you want to apply, and how easy it spreads thorough out. It is easy and fast to use, does not afd too much time to your routine, and you can see the results instantly. Leaves my akin feeling auper soft and adds and extra glow

I received these product for free from Influenster and philosophy in exchange for my honest review. I'm completely in love with this product, my skin felt instantly hydrated, glowing and smooth after the first application.
I like that this product doesn't feel abrasive. It's a light exfoliant that feels like a nice finishing touch after a regular face wash.
I just tried this product for the first time and hot dog!!! It made my skin feel so soft and renewed LITERALLY! It will definitely be a staple product in my skincare routine going forward.

This was recommended to me by an Ulta employee while I was in the store.

this was the first time I ever used a product That get all the extra dead skin off your face. I do have sensitive skin so after I used it for the first time I did have a breakout. is make sure you read the instructions cause you only should use it once a week for this reason. the smell was good and the product was very easy to use and get off the face. I probably wouldn't buy it cause is I feel my regular face on wash goes the same when it comes to exfoliating. definitely something new.

I have sensitive skin that really starts to dry out in the winter. I don't like physical exfoliation because it can feel too harsh so this was right up my alley. It is so gentle that the first time using it I wasn't sure it was actually working. I ended up with soft, smooth skin. I was even able to use it multiple times in a week. Highly recommend!

I have combination oily and dry skin. It is gently on my skin which is surprising that it works well with my skin type. I love a good exfoliation as it removes dead skin buildup yet still gentle. It's nice addition to my routine.

I have mixed feelings about this product. The scent is really nice and fresh and the packaging is great. I have pretty normal skin, slightly on the dry side on the winter, and while I enjoy a more gentle exfoliant I don't feel like this one did much for my face besides make my skin a little soft. I didn't really enjoy the texture of it or how it rolled up either.

It worked okay however it must have stripped more oil than my face wanted because it seemed great and then my face over compensated and became very greasy for a day or two which caused break outs. I don't doubt that it will work for some people but it didn't agree with my face.
liked this product, it smooths my skin and like the consistency. the packaging is very helpful. the highlights of the product are very nice, vegan no parabens, AHA/Glycolic acid.

I love this product, I've tried other products but this one worked so well for me. After using it as the instructions said, I immediately felt the difference in my skin. My face was baby soft for the next few days and it was amazing! Definitely worth the price and I'm so thankful I got to try it out. I will definitely be buying this one I'm all out of the one I was sent!!!

I have combination oily and dry skin. I used this for two weeks 2-3 times each week on non consecutive days. It totally worked to remove dead skin buildup and was gentler on my skin than other physical exfoliants I've used. After using my skin was visibly smoother and makeup went on better. The scent is light and feminine. Exfoliating is a must for me with all the mask wearing and I definitely recommend to my friends who have similar mask buildup! I will use this as needed no more than twice in the month during winter because too much exfoliating can and will dry you out! Pro-tip: make sure your skin is completely dry before using or you aren't getting the full product impact.

this is just a type of product that I forget to use and I have so many of them. it's ok but idk about the wrinkle guarantee that it claims. the packaging is nice and overall I guess I can't complain but not something I'd rush to the store to get again.
I liked this product. I think that it made my skin look fresh and healthy. I would continue to purchase this product in the future.
I was weary about trying because I didn't know if it would impact my skin. Seeing how much dead skin that came off my skin was incredible. afterwards, my face felt so much smoother

This isn't what I expected at all. I thought I'd be able to peel off the mask for some reason but all you do is apply and massage in circular motions. After I rinsed it off, however, it did make my skin look much brighter and clearer. My face was red for a bit but nothing crazy considering it is an exfoliating product. I'd recommend this product!

avis.titre: Best product for dead skin on face !!!!
avis.texte: I've been looking for a good cleanser that gets rid of dead skin on my face also not too rough. I get lots of dead skin around my nose and my t-zone and it's a bummer to find a gentle scrub. Went to Ulta and was suggested this product, let me tell you this ! This product is amazing !!!! It leaves my skin soo soft and refresh after one use !! And the best part is it's super gentle on your face! It cleans your face and takes off the dead skins that you never knew existed !!! I love it soo much and will continue to purchase and recommend this product to friends and family !!!!!

I had high hopes this. I liked the consistency, the smell and color of the product - asthetically, it was pleasing to the eye. Unfortunately, it made my skin super dry and I didn't see much improvement with my skin. The smell was a bit overpowering but it wasn't completely off-putting. If you're sensitive to smells, stay away.

This product is the best. I've been using it since I've received it. First of all when you are don't using it you skin is SO soft. But after a few weeks of use, my skin is remaining to feel this way even in between using it and not. I will definitely be purchasing this again when this tube runs out. And encourage you to purchase it too!
Love this product - I can see a difference in my skin. Highly recommend and will continue use moving forward.

If you are wanting instantly soft hydrated skin - this is a must try! I use it once a week. I will say my only complaint is that I wish the bottle was bigger because I will be repurchasing after about 1.5 months of using!
didnt like how it felt when putting this on, taking it off felt weird because it had bit and pieces sitting on my face. I'm not a fan of products like this to much stuff going on I wouldnt recommen
Great product from a great brand! Love how exfoliating it is and the subtle pineapple smell is great! It leaves my skin super soft and helps even my skin tone.

I have been a fan of this line for years so I was pleased to be able to try this product. I have been trying it a couple times a week and love the fresh feeling of my skin right before bed. It leaves me feeling so refreshed and clean after removing my makeup at the end of the day.

Loved this product! Best facial exfoliating product I've used. It's gentle while still feeling like it's doing what it's meant to do. Great texture, smell, and always leaves my face feeling amazing. Definitely something I will likely purchase again.

The product is enjoyable to use and has a nice cleansing sensation that comes with the peeling. I feel like my skin is refreshed and glowy after using it, but I don't know that it has a real lasting effect at this point.

I liked this product. I think that it makes my skin feels and look smooth. I did not find it to cause harm to my sensitive skin and I loved the texture. I could be a great addition to a regimen, however, I will need more time to see more results. So far, it is a product worth of consideration. I like the smell, too.
I love that it has exfoliating scrub in this face wash, but it is also very gentle and will not scratch your face even with a decent amount of pressure!

avis.titre: maybe a glow, but strange to me
avis.texte: I've never used a mask like this one. it was interesting. my skin looked and felt fantastic afterwards, so I'll give it that. but the application of it was odd to me.

I really liked the gentle exfoliating power of this. It made my face feel clean and soft. I will consider adding this to my cleansing routine a couple times a week. It works on my sensitive skin, so I would recommend to others.

I really didn't set my expectations very high with this stuff. I've seen it and this brand every where I shopped for make up/skin care and figured just another expensive known brand that does minimal to no improvement. I was wrong... this stuff makes my skin feel like 3 times lighter and leaves you feeling clean and refreshed
I've waited a month to write a review and notice a difference in my skin. It's much smoother. This does a great job exfoliating and clearing acne.
It makes my skin feel so smooth. I love the texture of it. A little tingly, but that means it's working!

This stuff is definitely a miracle in a tube. My skin was having the worst flare up and it was dull looking. I applied this peel after washing my face and then moisturizer. This was a great addition to my regimen

I was pleasantly surprised by this product. It really works... and how do I know? because the stuff I slough off my face is grey. GREY. That is ALL dead skin. And my skin really looks brighter and more even-toned afterwards. It's also gentle enough for me to use multiple times a week (I have the kind of skin that definitely needs regular exfoliation). Worth the coins, will purchase when it runs out for sure.

I have never had such soft skin after using a face product! It's quick, easy, and so effective! I have been using consistently for about a month and my skin looks so great! Will definitely be purchasing again!

First of all I love the smell of it. It smells fresh and leaves you feeling fresh! It starts working instantly as you begin to rub it on your face. It leaves your face feeling very smooth and also you can physically see the smoothness. (My favorite part!) I used it every other night as my skin gets easily irritated for constant touching. I highly recommend for any type of skin.

This stuff does the job. You can immediately feel and see it working, even after just one use, my skin felt smooth and glowing. Follow up with a moisturizer to feel the smoothness, as if I went and had a professional treatment done. I give it a 10/10 and would recommend it! This exfoliant is amazing. It isn't harsh, or grainy. It contains Pineapple Fruit Extract to Gently exfoliate the skin, Witch Hazel Water to minimize the appearance of pores, and refines skin, Cornflower Extract to visibly reduce redness. It smells nice & I love the fact that it contains a clean/vegan formula. I definitely will keep this as part of my skincare routine.

I asked a girl in the store for a tinted moisturizer due to having dryer skin in the winter to the point where make up looked crazy and she told me to try this and I was skeptical because she tried it on the back of my hand but it really works even after one use. I will absolutely keep using this in the winter to help with extra dry patches!

I really liked this product! As with any exfoliating treatment, it's definitely important for me to moisturize afterward to prevent dryness. I do think this took that winter dry skin off my face, and it had a light fresh smell. I would recommend this to others. I have sensitive skin, and it did not seem to bother my skin. I do only use it 1-2 times per week though, as not to overdo it. I received this complimentary from Influenster.

I loved this so much. I'm always on the fence about bringing anything into my current skin routine, especially now that I'm in my 30's.. but this was so great. It goes on kind of sticky, but you can immediately see and feel the dead skin coming off as you rub in circles. I think it would be great for anyone with sensitive skin because it's much less abrasive than other exfoliators that I've used. I definitely plan on buying more once my tube runs out.

I love this face peel! It definitely got a lot of dead skin off of my face! This was the first time I've used it and loved the afterglow it gave. This also smells great and a little bit goes a long way. I would definitely recommend!

My skin has felt so smooth and refreshed since I started using this. I use it at night twice a week. I'm such an advocate for regular skincare and anything that makes my skin feel refreshed from a long day is great in my book.

*I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest review* Wow!! This stuff is magical. My skin is somewhat sensitive and I had zero issues with irritation or any discomfort while using this which is super important. I already have plans to purchase this at retail when I run out because I am so impressed. It is easy to add to your skincare routine and you can start to notice a difference within a few days. 10/10 would recommend. My mother already went out and purchased her own after trying mine!

I like this product but it took a while for me to notice my glow. but I will continue to use it with my additional face products that I use I do have sensitive skin so I can't use it a lot because I'm afraid that my face will break out but I will use it once a week for sure

I love philosophy products and this one has to be the best I've tried so far! I could feel instant results and after 4 or 5 uses I can see amazing results. My face feels smooth after each use and glowing the rest of the week. The product peels up as you rub in circles on your face.. it's a less abrasive form of exfoliate and probably the best product I've tried through influenster!

I love this product. I love that it leaves my face feeling soft and looking radiant. it has a scent but it's subtle, light, and beautiful. All over a great win in my book. I would recommend this to friends and family for sure.

I believe this is a reformulated product from philosophy. I loved the old formula and excited to test out if this is the same or if something is different. You can actually see the dead skin cells leave!

I love the combination of physical smoothing properties and an exfoliating enzyme complex. Helps improve dry skin achieving a smoother and younger texture. To use, apply an adequate amount to clean, dry skin, massage for a few minutes and rinse. For best results it is recommended to use it 2 to 3 times a week. It is safe for all skin types.
It smells very nice and skin also feels soft after using it. But I have breakouts every time I use it.

I love this brand! The pealing mousse was a fun product to use. I love the blue color and actually seeing it gently exfoliate. It did not cause irritation or breakouts on this overly sensitive skin. The pineapple extract and vitamin B is a plus.

I wanted to love it, but it didn't work for me. I felt my skin so dry after using it and I didn't like that at all. I don't know, I may give it a try once the weather changes, because my skin gets really dry during the winter and I need extra moisture.

I love Philosophy brand. This pealing mousse leaves my skin glowing and soft. No redness and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I like that it has pineapple extract and vitamin b 5. Without parabens & vegan. I definitely keeping this for my skin care staple.

I really enjoy all philosophy products but this is a new one for me. I am not big on using exfoliation on my face because it is sensitive but this did a great job cleaning up without breaking down. Light scent and simple process made this an easy one to add to my routine.

It is a very good exfoliant. From the first use I felt my face softer, smoother and more radiant. It does deep cleaning, because after several uses I started to have an acne breakout. Which means that it cleans deeply. Its scent is mild and it actually smells good. i can't use it as much as i would like to because i have extremely dry skin right now. The product is very good. I can currently use the product 1 time, maximum 2 times a week.

i have dry/combo skin that's a little sensitive. I felt that this did work at making my skin look cleaner and fresher. the only reason I gave it a 4 is because the consistency was a bit different for me. almost reminded me of a mixture of toothpaste (but not as sticky) and an exfoliant. Some of it kind of flaked off while rubbish into the skin. I tend to rub my cleansers for a while though. however functionwise, this does well

This is a miracle product, i was a bit concerned to use it since i have a very sensitive product, but then i read the instructions and sensitive skin can use it once a week, but once a week is enough! My skin is so soft, i used it last night and so many people asked me today what products i use since my skin was looking glowy. I feel my skin super soft and healthier than ever. Pls try! Is a must have product < 3
My skin feels clean and soft after using it. I have never tried a peeling product, what a great surprise! Definitely recommend it!

I really like this product. it was light and not heavy feeling, I felt it was gentle on my skin and had a pleasant smell. the packaging news nice and simple and clean. The only thing I'd change now maybe making the writing with instructions a little bit bigger, it was kind of hard to read. other than that two thumbs up!

My skin feels smoother after using the product consistently lol. It has helped me stick to a skincare routine because it feels like I'm "scrubbing " away any excess impurities after a normal cleansing.
My face did feel very fresh and bright and clean. It doesn't feel gritty , very smooth . Will definitely keep using!! And look to buy when I run out !!

I actually had my hopes up for this one. It didn't quite make my expectations. It leaves your skin a bit glowy but it also leaves your skin a little greasy after. I don't think this is something I'd purchase.
I was excited for this voxbox! However, every time I use this peeling mousse, I have breakouts.

This does exfoliate my face very well and I'm surprised it only has to be used for one minute. I don't like how it pills on my fingers as I'm massaging. I feel like the product clumps up and I'm just moving and mushing around the clumps.

I was so excited to receive this #complimentary @lovephilosophy hope in a jar instant glow peeling mousse from @influenster and it didn't disappoint even for my sensitive skin! Left it feeling fresh and glowing so I would highly recommend! #influenster #philosophyhope #voxbox #boostofhope

I love the clean scent and feeling. There is a slight tingle (not burning) while the product works. The texture is similar to Wishful's exfoliating mask, but not as rubbery. I don't see radical exfoliating results, but maybe I need to use it more. The box says to use it 3x a week, and that it how many times I've tried it so far. I would recommend this to people with sensitive skin.

I love how easy it is to use this peel and how gentle it is. My skin feels so much softer every time I use it. I like how it smells but it would have been great if it was fragrance free. Other than that it's great to have.
This product works like a scrub, it leaves your skin feeling squeaky clean, I have really been enjoying using this a couple of times a week and would say it's pretty gentle! ￼

My skin has been so dry this winter so I was very excited to receive Philosophy's new exfoliating mousse. This product was much gentler than other exfoliating products I've tried. It has a mild and fresh scent and is super gentle on the skin. It wasn't able to help brush away all of my dry patches but it made a noticeable difference. This product is perfect for those who are looking for something less abrasive.

I got this peeling cream from influenster and it's my first time trying this product. first of all really like the smell of it. after applying this peeling mousse onto my face and washed I can tell my face feels very smooth and clean I'm so impressed.

I really like this mousse. The texture is a little interesting, but it did really leave my skin feeling soft right after. I haven't noticed my dark spots fading just yet but I'm happy with the soft skin and assume the spots will take some time to fade.
The technology in this product is unique and I'd definitely recommend. The formula preformed wonderful on my skin. Well done

avis.titre: Love this instant glow peeling mousse!
avis.texte: I have never had a peeling mousse before and I sure was missing out! I absolutely love this product and the size of the bottle for easy storage/travel. My skin feels so clean after using my normal face wash and then using this afterwards. With this mousse, your skin will feel smoother and looks more even/brighter with all the dead skin and impurities removed. It can make your skin feel a bit dry so be sure to follow with a good moisturizer. I tend to have sensitive skin and this worked great for me. I highly recommend incorporating this into your skincare routine! I use this every other day now.

Makes my skin soft and leaves it glowing. As I use it I can feel the grime and dead skin being removed. Left feeling so fresh, and it smells wonderful. I don't use it as directed only because I have sensitive skin, I don't want to over use it, and cause any type of skin irritation, but I'm happy with the results so far.
